name: Blade Bite
description: You engulf your weapon in destructive energy. As part of the action used to cast this spell, you must make a melee attack against one creature within the spell's range, otherwise the spell fails. On a hit, the target suffers the attack's normal effects, and it takes 1d6 necrotic damage as the spell's energy rips into it. This spell's necrotic damage increases by 1d6 when you reach 5th level (2d6), 11th level (3d6), and 17th level (4d6).
higherLevel: This spell's damage increases by 1d6 when you reach 5th level (2d6), 11th level (3d6), and 17th level (4d6).

name: Booster Pulse
description: You boost the energy of a creature you touch. If that creature takes the Attack action on its next turn, it can make one additional weapon attack or attack roll as part of that action. If the creature is wielding a weapon that deals piercing damage, it can also push the target of that attack up to 10 feet away from it on a hit. If the additional attack hits, the target takes an extra 1d4 force damage. The spell's extra damage increases by 1d4 when you reach 5th level (2d4), 11th level (3d4), and 17th level (4d4).
higherLevel: The spell's extra damage increases by 1d4 when you reach 5th level (2d4), 11th level (3d4), and 17th level (4d4).

name: Gravity Shift
description: You alter gravity around a creature within range. The target must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be pulled up to 10 feet in a direction of your choice. This spell ends if the target touches the ground or a solid surface. At 5th level, you can pull the target up to 15 feet. At 11th level, you can pull the target up to 20 feet. At 17th level, you can pull the target up to 25 feet.
higherLevel: At 5th level, you can pull the target up to 15 feet. At 11th level, you can pull the target up to 20 feet. At 17th level, you can pull the target up to 25 feet.

name: Sapping Sting
description: You sap the vitality of one creature you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take 1d4 necrotic damage and have disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn. This spell's damage increases by 1d4 when you reach 5th level (2d4), 11th level (3d4), and 17th level (4d4).
higherLevel: This spell's damage increases by 1d4 when you reach 5th level (2d4), 11th level (3d4), and 17th level (4d4).

name: Void Writing
description: You can write on any surface, but the writing is visible only to creatures you specify. The writing appears on the surface as normal writing, but it is invisible to all other creatures. The writing lasts for the duration, but it can be ended early by you as a bonus action.

name: Dialing Disruption
description: You disrupt a creature's concentration. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take 1d8 force damage and if it is concentrating on a spell, it must immediately make a Constitution saving throw to maintain concentration. This spell's damage increases by 1d8 when you reach 5th level (2d8), 11th level (3d8), and 17th level (4d8).
higherLevel: This spell's damage increases by 1d8 when you reach 5th level (2d8), 11th level (3d8), and 17th level (4d8).

name: Pressure Reversal
description: You reverse gravity around you. Each creature within 5 feet of you must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or be pushed 10 feet away from you and take 1d6 force damage. This spell's damage increases by 1d6 when you reach 5th level (2d6), 11th level (3d6), and 17th level (4d6).
higherLevel: This spell's damage increases by 1d6 when you reach 5th level (2d6), 11th level (3d6), and 17th level (4d6).

name: Precision Beam
description: You fire a beam of energy at a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 1d8 radiant damage. This spell's damage increases by 1d8 when you reach 5th level (2d8), 11th level (3d8), and 17th level (4d8).
higherLevel: This spell's damage increases by 1d8 when you reach 5th level (2d8), 11th level (3d8), and 17th level (4d8).

name: Umbramancy
description: You manipulate shadows around you. Until the spell ends, you can use a bonus action to become invisible until the start of your next turn, or until you attack, deal damage, or force someone to make a saving throw.

name: Touch of the Void
description: You touch a creature with void energy. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take 1d8 cold damage and have its speed reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn. This spell's damage increases by 1d8 when you reach 5th level (2d8), 11th level (3d8), and 17th level (4d8).
higherLevel: This spell's damage increases by 1d8 when you reach 5th level (2d8), 11th level (3d8), and 17th level (4d8).

name: Intellect Fortress
description: For the duration, you or one willing creature you can see within range has resistance to psychic damage, as well as advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws.

name: Spirit Shroud
description: You call spirits of the dead, which flit around you for the duration. Until the ends, any attack you make deals 1d8 extra damage when you hit a creature within 10 feet of you. This extra damage is of a type determined by the type of spirit you call: radiant, necrotic, or cold (your choice). If the attack hits a Large or smaller creature, it must also succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of you until the end of your next turn.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for every two slot levels above 3rd.

name: Summon Aberration
description: You call forth an aberration spirit. It manifests in an unoccupied space that you can see within range. This corporeal form uses the Aberration Spirit stat block. When you cast the spell, choose a type of watcher, slicer, or slime. The creature resembles an aberration of that type, which determines certain traits in the creature's stat block.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the creature's statistics change as described in the spell's description.

name: Summon Fey
description: You call forth a fey spirit. It manifests in an unoccupied space that you can see within range. This corporeal form uses the Fey Spirit stat block. When you cast the spell, choose a brisk, gentle, or phantasmal spirit. The creature resembles a fey of that type, which determines certain traits in the creature's stat block.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the creature's statistics change as described in the spell's description.

name: Summon Shadowspawn
description: You call forth a shadowy spirit. It manifests in an unoccupied space that you can see within range. This corporeal form uses the Shadow Spirit stat block. When you cast the spell, choose a fury, despair, or fear spirit. The creature resembles a shadow of that type, which determines certain traits in the creature's stat block.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the creature's statistics change as described in the spell's description.

name: Summon Undead
description: You call forth an undead spirit. It manifests in an unoccupied space that you can see within range. This corporeal form uses the Undead Spirit stat block. When you cast the spell, choose a ghostly, putrid, or skeletal spirit. The creature resembles an undead of that type, which determines certain traits in the creature's stat block.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the creature's statistics change as described in the spell's description.

name: Otherworldly Form
description: You draw on the magic of the Lower Planes or the Upper Planes (your choice) to transform yourself, gaining the following benefits for the duration: Your eyes become pools of darkness, and you gain darkvision with a range of 60 feet. You gain a fly speed equal to your walking speed and can hover. You gain resistance to either fire or necrotic damage (your choice). Your weapons are imbued with otherworldly energy. When you hit with a melee weapon attack, you can deal an extra 1d6 force damage. You gain a +1 bonus to your spell save DC.

name: Psychic Scream
description: You unleash the power of your mind to blast the intellect of up to ten creatures of your choice that you can see within range. Creatures that have an Intelligence score of 2 or lower are unaffected. Each target must make an Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes 14d6 psychic damage and is stunned. On a successful save, a target takes half as much damage and isn't stunned.
